# Progress Bar

Progress bars communicate how much of a process has completed. The linear bar comes in three heights and four styles with an optional label and helper note; the circular bar comes in five diameters with a percentage or state icon at its center. Ported from the DGA library's dga-linear-progress-bar and dga-circular-progress-bar components.

**Stylesheet:** `components/progress-bar/progress-bar.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes and data attributes, mapped from the library's dga-linear-progress-bar and dga-circular-progress-bar APIs.

| Class / Attribute | Type | Library prop | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.progress-wrapper` | Base (linear) | — | Column layout holding the label, the track, and the helper note. |
| `.progress-bar-container.sm\|.md\|.lg` | Modifier | `size` | Track heights 4 / 8 / 16px. The large size rounds to 8px radius and can show the value inside the fill. |
| `.progress-bar.primary\|.neutral\|.error\|.success` | Modifier | progress-style, error, success | Fill color. Width is set inline as a percentage; it animates over 0.5s. |
| .progress-bar__label / .progress-bar__note | Element | label, helper-text | Optional label above and icon + note below. The note tone follows error/success. |
| `.circular-progress-bar` | Base (circular) | — | Declarative: set data-size, data-percentage, data-variant, data-text and the page script renders the SVG ring (stroke = diameter / 10). |
| `data-size="200\|160\|120\|80\|64"` | Attribute | `size` | Ring diameter. Center typography and icon scale per size; the text label hides at 80 and 64. |
| `data-variant="primary\|neutral\|error\|success"` | Attribute | `variant` | Ring color. Success and error swap the center percentage for a state icon. |

## Linear Sizes

Three track heights. The large bar carries its percentage inside the fill once it passes 8%.

```html
<div class="progress-wrapper">
    <h3 class="progress-bar__label">Small (4px)</h3>
    <div class="progress-bar-container sm"><div class="progress-bar primary" style="width:65%;"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="progress-wrapper">
    <h3 class="progress-bar__label">Medium (8px)</h3>
    <div class="progress-bar-container md"><div class="progress-bar primary" style="width:65%;"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="progress-wrapper">
    <h3 class="progress-bar__label">Large (16px)</h3>
    <div class="progress-bar-container lg">
        <div class="progress-bar primary" style="width:65%;"><span class="progress-bar-text">65%</span></div>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Linear Styles & States

Primary and neutral fills for running processes; error and success recolor the fill and the helper note together.

```html
<div class="progress-wrapper">
    <h3 class="progress-bar__label">Uploading file</h3>
    <div class="progress-bar-container md"><div class="progress-bar primary" style="width:65%;"></div></div>
    <div class="progress-bar__note">
        <span class="progress-bar__note-icon icon dga-icon-help-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <p>Your file is being uploaded</p>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="progress-wrapper">
    <h3 class="progress-bar__label">Processing</h3>
    <div class="progress-bar-container md"><div class="progress-bar neutral" style="width:40%;"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="progress-wrapper">
    <h3 class="progress-bar__label">Uploading file</h3>
    <div class="progress-bar-container md"><div class="progress-bar error" style="width:35%;"></div></div>
    <div class="progress-bar__note">
        <span class="progress-bar__note-icon error icon dga-icon-cancel-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <p class="error">Upload failed. Try again.</p>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="progress-wrapper">
    <h3 class="progress-bar__label">Uploading file</h3>
    <div class="progress-bar-container md"><div class="progress-bar success" style="width:100%;"></div></div>
    <div class="progress-bar__note">
        <span class="progress-bar__note-icon success icon dga-icon-checkmark-circle-02" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <p class="success">Upload complete</p>
    </div>
</div>
```

## Circular Sizes

Five diameters with a stroke of one tenth of the size. The center percentage scales with the ring; the optional text label hides at 80px and below.

```html
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="200" data-percentage="65" data-variant="primary" data-text="Completed"></div>
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="160" data-percentage="65" data-variant="primary" data-text="Completed"></div>
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="120" data-percentage="65" data-variant="primary" data-text="Completed"></div>
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="80" data-percentage="65" data-variant="primary"></div>
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="64" data-percentage="65" data-variant="primary"></div>
```

## Circular Variants

Primary and neutral rings show the running percentage; success and error complete the ring and swap the center for a state icon.

```html
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="120" data-percentage="65" data-variant="primary"></div>
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="120" data-percentage="65" data-variant="neutral"></div>
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="120" data-percentage="100" data-variant="success" data-text="Done"></div>
<div class="circular-progress-bar" data-size="120" data-percentage="100" data-variant="error" data-text="Failed"></div>
```

## RTL Layout

In right-to-left layouts the linear fill anchors to the right edge and the note mirrors.

```html
<div class="progress-wrapper">
    <h3 class="progress-bar__label">جاري رفع الملف</h3>
    <div class="progress-bar-container md"><div class="progress-bar primary" style="width:65%;"></div></div>
    <div class="progress-bar__note">
        <span class="progress-bar__note-icon icon dga-icon-help-circle" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <p>يتم رفع الملف الآن</p>
    </div>
</div>
```
